target.title: [codex] fix(sessions): report archive cleanup in sessions cleanup
target.body:
Fixes #75658

## What Problem This Solves

`openclaw sessions cleanup --dry-run` did not preview stale `.deleted.*` and `.reset.*` archive files, and the apply summary did not report when those physical archive files were removed. Operators could see only unreferenced-artifact counts even when deleted/reset session archives were consuming disk.

## What Changed

- Reuse the configured archive-retention rules for cleanup preview and apply reporting.
- Run archive preview before disk-budget simulation and exclude already-attributed archive paths from later cleanup phases.
- Preserve configured archive retention when cleanup runs through the SQLite lifecycle boundary.
- Resolve archive directories correctly for direct per-agent SQLite targets.
- Deduplicate shared-directory archive previews and keep per-agent applied summaries aligned with their targets.
- Clear reset-archive discovery caches and notify transcript subscribers after successful archive deletion, including the source transcript path needed by connected history streams.
- Count only successful deletions; dry-run never emits mutation notifications.

The rebase dropped an obsolete `runtime-types.ts` conflict hunk because current `main` no longer uses that surface.

## User Impact

Users running `sessions cleanup` now see deleted/reset archive cleanup in dry-run and apply output. Forced cleanup scans the canonical archive directory even when no session rows were removed, while `resetArchiveRetention: false` still preserves reset archives.

## Exact-Head Evidence

Rebased onto `main` at `1644bef7908`; pushed head `3249d697648`.

- Focused cleanup/accessor/archive suite: 7 files, 142 tests passed.
- Focused `oxfmt` check passed on all touched TypeScript files.
- Direct type-aware `oxlint` passed on all touched TypeScript files.
- Session accessor boundary guard passed.
- Dead-code unused-file and unused-export guards passed.
- `git diff --check origin/main...HEAD` passed.
- Exact-head Codex review against `origin/main` completed with no actionable findings.

The repository lint wrapper itself was also attempted. Its package-boundary preflight stopped in untouched upstream file `src/gateway/worker-environments/bundle.ts` with TS7053 before invoking lint on the PR files; direct type-aware lint on the PR surface passed.

Real CLI proof on pushed head, with the temporary path redacted:

```text
$ openclaw sessions cleanup --store "$TMP/archive-store/sessions.json" --dry-run --enforce
Session store: $TMP/archive-store/sessions.json
Maintenance mode: enforce
Entries: 0 -> 0 (remove 0)
Would prune missing transcripts: 0
Would retire stale direct DM sessions: 0
Would prune stale model-run probes: 0
Would prune stale: 0
Would cap overflow: 0
Would prune deleted/reset archives: 2
Would prune unreferenced artifacts: 0

after dry-run:
fresh.jsonl.deleted.2026-07-12T00-00-00.000Z
old.jsonl.deleted.2026-01-01T00-00-00.000Z
old.jsonl.reset.2026-01-01T00-00-00.000Z
sessions.json

$ openclaw sessions cleanup --store "$TMP/archive-store/sessions.json" --enforce
Session store: $TMP/archive-store/sessions.json
Applied maintenance. Current entries: 0
Pruned deleted/reset archives: 2

after apply:
fresh.jsonl.deleted.2026-07-12T00-00-00.000Z
openclaw-agent.sqlite
sessions.json
```

## AI Assistance

AI-assisted: yes. Codex was used to inspect the issue and contributor rules, implement the patch, resolve the current-main rebase, run focused validation and CLI proof, and review the exact head.
